node.title: Re: Perl code to format the text file by inserting tag in blank line
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You should definitely use an appropriate module for this - see [id://1201438] for why. You said [id://11112838|here] that you have security restrictions, and I fully agree with [afoken] that not using the appropriate modules and instead reinventing the wheel makes it more likely that your code will be a security risk; you should speak to your managers about that. And you may already have the appropriate libraries installed anyway: [mod://XML::LibXML] is based on libxml2, and [mod://XML::Parser] (used in e.g. [mod://XML::Twig]) is based on libexpat.
